description: Headless Renovate (no PR workflow): minors and patches land directly on main; a broken bump fails the build in build-push-deploy@v3 and no image is pushed. Preset: homelab/default.json.

packageRules.description: All npm deps share one package-lock.json — bumped individually they produce mutual merge conflicts and stall as open PRs (this happened with 3 of them on 2026-08-01). One branch for all non-major JS updates means one lockfile change and no conflict. Majors stay individual and dashboard-gated.

goldmark stays on v1. The v2 module exists (github.com/yuin/goldmark/v2, latest v2.0.1) and a plain bump cannot reach it twice over: the module path gains a /v2 suffix, which needs `gomodUpdateImportPaths` rather than the `gomodTidy` this config sets, and the API moved as well — after rewriting the single import in internal/feed/atom.go, the build fails with `undefined: goldmark.New` and `undefined: goldmark.Markdown` at three call sites (lines 83, 149 and 219). Measured 2026-09-07 with go 1.27.1. This is a code migration for that file, not a dependency update; re-enable the rule as part of it.
